Important Information

Coverage: This map displays mapped flood-affected areas within eight Divisional Secretariat Divisions of Kandy District, based on field observations and information collected following Cyclone Ditwah. It does not represent the entire Kandy District.

Information Reliability: The information presented is based on available field survey data and observations and may not represent all flood-affected locations.

Disclaimer: This application does not provide real-time monitoring, flood forecasting, or future flood predictions. The information displayed should not be considered an official flood warning, a guarantee of safety, or a prediction of future flood events. Users are advised to follow official instructions and updates issued by relevant authorities. This application is intended for informational and awareness purposes only.

How to Use

📍 My Location
Use your device GPS location to check whether you were within the mapped flood inundation area.

🔍 Search a Place
Search for schools, hospitals, temples, stations, shops, tourist attractions, and other mapped locations.

🌊 Flood Depth Categories

  • High: > 3 m
  • Moderate: 1.5-3 m
  • Low: < 1.5 m

⚠️ Important
This map displays historical inundation from the Ditwah flood event. It is not a forecasting or flood warning system.

Place search is powered by OpenStreetMap data.
